courses.title: The Transforming Power of Ego Relaxation
courses.description: A self-paced online programme in nine modules, each with a recorded teaching of about an hour, an inquiry practice, meditation and journaling prompts. It works through her 'Pillars of Awakening', such as trust, humility, willingness and patience, as ways of relaxing the ego rather than fighting it.
